meta.name: Jordan Rivera
meta.title: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems, Go, and Platform Reliability

summary: Backend engineer with six years building services that stay up: cut p99 latency 60% on a 4B-request/month API, and led the migration off a 400k-line monolith without a customer-visible incident. Owns systems end to end — schema design, rollout, tracing, and on-call — and has built the platform tooling other teams depend on.
